title: Fixed tensor-cohomology windows on one scalar-perfect chart
statement:
Let Λ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], let S and U be schemes, and let g:U→S be weakly etale, so U is an object of the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Put B=Λ_S and B_U=Λ_U [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Let P∈D(Mod_B) [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories] and let F be a cochain complex of condensed Λ-module objects [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], vanishing outside a fixed ordered integral interval [a,b]. Suppose for each degree n there are maps F^n→Λ^{⊕r_n}→F^n whose composite is the identity [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package]. Let G be the point-to-U pullback on module objects, with its zero-morphism preservation witness explicit. Suppose g^*P≅Q(G(F)) in the derived category, where G(F) is its termwise application [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. For every B-module object N and every integer q, the abelian sheaf inverse images

g^*H^q(P⊗^L_B N[0]) and g^*H^q(RHom_B(P,B[0])⊗^L_B N[0])

are zero respectively when q<a or b<q, and when q<−b or −a<q. Derived tensor and internal Hom are the recorded relative functors [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom], and H^q is derived cohomology [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. There is no cover hypothesis, no choice of global bounds, no quasi-compactness hypothesis and no admissibility hypothesis.

proof.text: Identify U_proet with S_proet/U by weakly etale localization. The abelian inverse-image comparison identifies g^* with restriction; the canonical coefficient isomorphism g^*Λ_S≅Λ_U identifies the module-object pullback with restriction for the actual coefficient monoid, not a discrete constant ring. Apply the exact internal-module/section-ring derived comparison on U and on the localized site of S at U. Point pullback preserves finite coproducts and the regular module, so it sends the specified degreewise finite-free retractions of F to finite-free retractions of its scalar-extended complex E. It sends zero terms to zero terms. The comparison fixes the underlying abelian sheaves. No exactness or flatness of scalar extension is required for preservation of a splitting.

Apply splitPerfect_dual_torWindow to E with the supplied ordered interval [a,b] and the transported package. It gives the two universal local tensor vanishings, the signed dual Hom(E,B_U[0]), its finite-free-retract terms and its reflected interval [−b,−a]. In particular its K-injective comparison identifies this explicit dual with the recorded relative derived internal Hom.

The slice Hom compatibility of the comparison identifies the restriction of RHom_B(P,B[0]) with the computed chart dual. Exact restriction commutes with cohomology and with putting a module in degree zero. The canonical tensor-pullback isomorphism identifies each restricted global tensor with the local derived tensor against g^*N[0]. Test the two universal local vanishings on g^*N, then transport them through the equivalence, which fixes the underlying abelian sheaves. This is precisely each displayed abelian inverse-image vanishing, without any global descent or endpoint selection.

theorem scalarPerfect_chart_tor_vanishing
    (Λ : Mon (Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}))
    [IsCommMonObj Λ.X] {S U : Scheme.{u}} (g : U ⟶ S) [WeaklyEtale g]
    (P : DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology S) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ.X S)))
    (F : CochainComplex
      (Mod (Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) Λ.X) ℤ)
    (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hF : ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (F.X n))
    (hproj : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, ∃ i : F.X n ⟶ Mod.finiteFree Λ.X r,
      ∃ p : Mod.finiteFree Λ.X r ⟶ F.X n, i ≫ p = 𝟙 (F.X n))
    (hG : ((upperStarFromPoint U).mapMod Λ.X).PreservesZeroMorphisms)
    (hrep : letI := hG
      Nonempty (((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ.X g).mapDerivedCategory).obj P ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          ((((upperStarFromPoint U).mapMod Λ.X).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj F))) :
    ∀ (N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology S) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ.X S))
      (q : ℤ),
      (q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} g).obj
        (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
          (((CondensedRing.derivedTensor Λ.X S).obj P).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj N))).X))) ∧
      (q < -b ∨ -a < q → IsZero ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} g).obj
        (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
          (((CondensedRing.derivedTensor Λ.X S).obj
            (((CondensedRing.derivedHom Λ.X S).obj (Opposite.op P)).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
                (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj Λ.X S))))).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj N))).X)))
